questions.q: What does the standard telecommunications acronym 'IMEI' stand for in mobile phone terminology?
questions.explain: IMEI stands for International Mobile Equipment Identity, which is a unique 15-digit code assigned to identify specific mobile phones on a network.
questions.exam: WASSCE Setting Up and Managing Mobile Phone Workshop
questions.subject: Computer Hardware and GSM Repairs 1

questions.q: Before processing an intake form for a smartphone repair, a technician must digitally verify and record the phone's unique hardware identifier. Which universal USSD code instantly displays the IMEI number on nearly all mobile phones?
questions.explain: Dialing *#06# on the standard phone dialer is the globally recognized universal code used to display a mobile device's IMEI and serial number on the screen.

questions.q: Detailed record-keeping is critical during device intake. What is the main business benefit of meticulously documenting the 'customer-stated fault' alongside any distinct physical scratches before the repair begins?
options: It guarantees that the shop can mathematically charge higher labor fees.
It completely protects the workshop from a customer falsely claiming that a pre-existing scratch or fault was actively caused by the technician.
It vastly reduces the actual amount of time required to perform micro-soldering.
It formally allows the technician to legally bypass the actual logic board diagnostic phase.
questions.explain: Routinely documenting pre-existing operational faults and cosmetic damages at intake prevents expensive post-repair disputes over scratches or hardware issues that the customer might erroneously claim the technician created.

questions.q: Before formally accepting a dead device for a highly localized 'broken USB charging port replacement', the intake agent mandates testing and video-logging the front camera, rear camera, proximity sensor, and primary microphone. Which specific operational principle dictates this rigorous diagnostic action?
options: Executing comprehensive pre-repair operational diagnostics explicitly designed to defensively preclude subsequent fraudulent customer liability claims.
The Pareto Principle of statistical hardware mechanics.
questions.explain: Running and documenting extensive functional tests prior to opening the device shields the business. It unequivocally prevents a malicious or oblivious customer from alleging that the technician "broke the camera" while legally disassembling the phone to merely swap a faulty charging module.

questions.q: Within modern shop procedures, a formal Service Intake Job Card must explicitly detail granular physical observations of the client's chassis (e.g., 'deep gauge on bottom-right aluminum bezel'). Why is this procedural step paramount?
options: It strictly dictates how many raw electrical joules the shop needs to safely budget to re-flash the OS.
It establishes a formally signed, mutual historical agreement on the device's exact incoming physical condition to outright paralyze subsequent legal disputes regarding aesthetic shop damage.
It inherently provides the mathematical cipher required to calculate the device's internal IMEI digits.
It visually proves beyond doubt to law enforcement that the phone was completely untouched by local thieves.
questions.explain: Strictly noting existing housing cracks or severe bezel scratches completely prevents aggressive clients from extorting the shop with false claims that pristine phones were suddenly cosmetically mangled by a reckless technician during routine service.
